description: Run an arbitrary READ-ONLY GraphQL query against Remind's API. Introspection is enabled, so `{ __schema { ... } }` and `{ __type(name:"Class") { fields { name } } }` work for discovering fields the typed tools do not expose. Mutations are rejected — use the write tools, which preview the change and ask you to confirm first. Note: Remind reports an unknown field as a 500-backed GRAPHQL_VALIDATION_FAILED, not a field error.
name: remind_graphql
